## Verification

State the checks you actually ran and their results. Link a preview or attach a screenshot when it makes the change easier to review. If a relevant check was not run, explain why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The listed task acceptance criteria pass.
- [ ] Shared API/type changes were agreed with the affected member.
- [ ] No secrets, private image data, or unrelated generated files were committed.
- [ ] If affected, the UI handles loading, failure, and sample/mock labeling correctly.
- [ ] The reviewer has a clear way to verify the result.

**Handoff / follow-up:** recipient and next step, or “none”.

After merge, check the corresponding boxes in the workstream Issue. PR checklist boxes do not update workstream, Markdown, or PDF boxes.
